pages.title: Two Tracks
pages.text: Beasts are contracted partners; puppets are blueprint-crafted constructs. Both share a 0–20 XP curve with separate stage rules. See the Companion Growth entry for the full loop.

pages.title: Beasts Now
pages.text: Capture jars seal bestiary-tameable ecology beasts at ≤35% HP. Feeding and combat advance XP/affinity; authored thresholds require an operational Evolution Pool. Summon tier, HP, damage and lifespan scale with evolution. True spirits, exclusives and bosses stay non-capturable.

pages.title: Puppets Now
pages.text: Seven recipes need the matching blueprint (knowledge, not consumed) plus full materials. Assembly, hits, kills and repairs write a persistent owner core; levels 7/14/20 refine at a Puppet Core Forge. Death clone keeps progress; multipliers apply on later summons.

pages.title: Entry Points
pages.text: Spirit-taming halls, Thousand Bamboo content, related manuals and puppet arts are the main doors. Craft and summon stay server-authoritative with refunds and delivery outbox on full bags.

pages.title: Still Deferred
pages.text: Final GeckoLib art, live multiplayer smoke, and refreshing already-summoned puppets in place remain polish items. The gameplay loop itself is live.
